rules: Public visibility is not redistribution permission.
ACCESS_RESTRICTED assets must never have a download URL in the vault.
LOCAL_CACHED release assets require explicit redistribution permission and a local SHA-256.
Unknown or ambiguous rights remain REFERENCE_ONLY or DOWNLOAD_URL_UNRESOLVED.
No fetcher may bypass authentication, robots controls, paywalls, member gates, signed URL requirements or rate limits.
Per-file media rights override collection-level assumptions.
Source bytes never acquire geometry-write authority merely by being cached.
